home.phaseBadge: Phase 8 · Refunds, reports & driver map live
home.title: Book your bus seat with confidence
home.subtitle: One clean system for passengers, counter staff, drivers and administrators — with server-verified seat holds, so two people can never buy the same seat.

foundation.api: Express API with security middleware and rate limiting
foundation.db: Mongoose models, indexes and the seed script for MongoDB Atlas
foundation.ui: React shell with Tailwind design tokens and Bangla/English switching
foundation.auth: Sign-in, password reset, JWT httpOnly cookies and role guards
foundation.admin: Admin dashboard for buses, routes, drivers and trips
foundation.booking: Live trip search, interactive seat map and 2-minute server holds
foundation.tickets: Hold-to-ticket conversion, cash counter sales, SSLCommerz checkout and printable tickets
foundation.cancellations: Cancellation with policy-based refund tracking and an honest admin workflow
foundation.driver: Driver console with trip status, passenger manifest and a manual location map
foundation.reports: Sales reports with CSV export and totals built from stored bookings

next.deploy: Deployment setup for MongoDB Atlas, Render and Vercel is included
next.credentials: Real email, SMS and SSLCommerz credentials can be added when available

health.setupTitle: Connect MongoDB Atlas to finish the setup
health.setupSteps: Inside server/, copy .env.example to .env, paste your Atlas URI into MONGODB_URI, restart the backend, then run npm run seed.
health.copyEnv: Copy .env.example to .env inside server/ (Windows PowerShell: Copy-Item .env.example .env)
